thompson-gilgamish: R. Campbell Thompson, The Epic of Gilgamish: Text, Transliteration, and Notes (Oxford, 1930), read in the Source Library edition
rogers-cuneiform: Robert William Rogers, Cuneiform Parallels to the Old Testament (New York: Eaton & Mains, 1912), with Berossus' flood story from Syncellus, pp. 110-111
sumerian-flood-story: The Flood Story (Sumerian, Old Babylonian copy from Nippur), English translation in the Source Library (sourcelibrary.org)
frymer-kensky-bar1978: Tikva Frymer-Kensky, "What the Babylonian Flood Stories Can and Cannot Teach Us About the Genesis Flood," Biblical Archaeology Review (November/December 1978), as excerpted at the Center for Online Judaic Studies (cojs.org)
